Powered by Skip to main content Company Careers Sustainability News Events Site visit English Warehouse Solutions System Channels Industries Resources Contact Contact Warehouse Solutions System Channels Industries Resources Contact Company Careers Sustainability News Events Site visit English Your End-to-End Warehouse Solutions Provider Tour an Exotec Warehouse Exotec is an end-to-end warehouse automation integrator and technology manufacturer (OEM), delivering solutions that combine robotics, software, and operational expertise. We design, integrate, and deploy scalable warehouse solutions that support complex operations across industries. Over 75 brands across the globe rely on Exotec solutions for their warehouse operations. The Modern Approach to Warehouse Operations Every warehouse faces the same challenges every day, balancing cost, speed, and accuracy to deliver on your customer promise. When constraints tighten, the gaps between systems become exposed. At Exotec, we operate under a different philosophy: one that is more flexible, reliable, and offers faster time to value than legacy automation solutions. Flexible Our modular, plug-and-play solutions scale and reconfigure on demand without disrupting operations. Reliable We define outcomes upfront and uphold rigorous standards. Results are transparent and measurable over time. Faster Time to Value Move from decision to impact—fast. Modular, connected systems speed up installation and results. Designed to Scale With Your Business End-To-End Solutions Rooted in Elegant Engineering Our all-in-one AS/RS is designed to remove unnecessary equipment and streamline the flow of your warehouse. Since we build and deploy our own products, we can ensure the hardware delivers the best output. Learn More The Sole Provider for Your Entire Ecosystem As a full-service integrator, we work as part of your team, deeply understanding your challenges and working together to achieve the same goals. Understand Our Approach The Brain Behind Your Operations All hardware within your solution is orchestrated by one software layer: our WES, Deepsky. This gives you complete control over the flow of goods in the warehouse without having to customize individual software modules for each subsystem. Its flexibility to adapt to any new system allows you to see faster time to value from your complete solution. Learn More No Unnecessary Equipment. No Bottlenecks. Exotec’s compact grocery solutions help maximize warehouse space and accelerate fulfillment. The impact is tangible: one customer achieved a 56% revenue increase within three years of implementation.
